description: Select by colour (Select > Color Range): pixels near a sampled colour within a fuzziness, or a preset range (reds ... magentas, highlights, midtones, shadows, out of gamut), optionally inverted. Works inside the current selection when there is one, and samples the active layer

color.description: The colour to select (Sampled Colors). "#RRGGBB", "rgb(r,g,b)" (0-255), "cmyk(c,m,y,k)" (0-100), "gray(g)" (0-100, 100 = black), "hsb(h,s,b)" (0-360, 0-100, 0-100) or "lab(L,a,b)"

fuzziness.description: Sampled colours and highlights/midtones/shadows: how far from the colour or tone still counts. Default 40

preset.description: A preset range instead of a colour

range.description: highlights, midtones or shadows: the [lower, upper] tonal limits, 0-255

name: select_color_range
title: Select Color Range
